image_description: A street scene featuring a horizontal traffic light assembly suspended over an intersection. The assembly consists of three distinct signal heads mounted on a black mast arm. Each head appears to be a vertical traffic light unit with red lights illuminated at the top. The background shows bare trees against a pale sky, and a paved road with lane markings below.
